en.label: Latest
en.title: Owned-photo visual refresh
changes: The tray pinboard preview now uses four owned photos of snowy mountains, blossoms, sunset, and lakeside scenery in a refined collage.
The website hero, feature demos, social preview, and GitHub README now share the same owned-photo visual language.
Privacy and copyright wording now clearly identifies showcase imagery as owned photos and interface mockups.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
